briefing.orders:
Cleared ILS 28. Descend 4000ft.
Expect vectors from LOBEP. Speed 250kt below FL100.
Gear down abeam threshold. Full flaps by FAP.
Decision height: 700ft. Go-around: climb 5000ft, track 283°.
briefing.atmosphere:
Long-haul inbound from San Francisco — fourteen hours behind you.
Live METAR active. Weather may differ from brief.
Open kneeboard (K) for full approach plate.

briefing.orders:
Start engines (E key). Taxi to RWY 22 via Foxtrot and November.
Hold short — one departure ahead. Cleared takeoff when ready.
Maintain RWY heading to 1000ft AGL. Squawk 4712.
Climb FL240, routing to München (EDDM). Mont Blanc at 12 o'clock.
briefing.atmosphere:
Live METAR active.
Geneva — Lake to the right, mountains straight ahead.
Helvetica. Clean, efficient, on time.

briefing.orders:
Cleared ILS 27L. Descend FL100, speed 250kt below.
Expect LOREL arrival via WILLO. Vectors to localizer.
Gear down by 2500ft. Flaps full by FAP.
Decision height: 200ft. Go-around: climb 3000ft, track 270°.
briefing.atmosphere:
Runway 27L. The busiest approach in Europe.
You've flown this dozens of times.
But every landing is the first.

briefing.orders:
Stable at FL350, 290kt. Baltic Sea ahead left.
Request descent via Vilnius — target FL240 then approach.
Approach brief due at 9500ft (opens automatically).
ILS 36, course 360°, DH 200ft.
briefing.atmosphere:
Live METAR at EVRA active.
Air Baltic. The whole fleet is A220. Every aircraft, every route.

briefing.orders:
Start all 4 engines (E key). Taxi to RWY 14.
Cleared takeoff — wind 130° at 12kt.
V1 162kt  Vr 165kt  V2 181kt. Heavy — 275t.
Maintain RWY heading to 3000ft. Climb FL370.
briefing.atmosphere:
Sunrise over the Indian Ocean. Warm, humid.
Edelweiss Air — Zürich bound. 10h 40min ahead.
4 engines. Long haul. The way it used to be done.

briefing.orders:
Depart Grenchen runway 26. Climb westbound.
Track over Bielersee at 4500ft.
Side approach Neuchâtel from east. Runway 23.
Land. Fuel if needed. Depart runway 05.
Return Grenchen via Bielersee. Runway 26.
briefing.atmosphere:
You flew this route before.
You were in the right seat then.
Now you fly it.

briefing.orders:
Platzrunde links. Platzhöhe 2200ft QNH.
Piste 26 · Asphalt · 900m.
Crosswind bei 800ft AGL links eindrehen.
Endanflug 70kt, Klappen 30°. Aufsetzen bei den Zahlen.
briefing.atmosphere:
Low wing. Stick, not yoke.
You flew this aircraft already.

briefing.orders:
Left-hand circuit. Circuit altitude 2200ft QNH.
Runway 26 · Asphalt · 900m.
Vr 55kt · Vy 70kt · Approach 65kt.
Land with ≥ 27% SOC. No go-around below that.
briefing.atmosphere:
Nearly silent.
No magnetos. No carb heat. No mixture.
Watch the EPSI. Manage your energy.
HB-SYC. The same one.

briefing.orders:
Circuits to the north. Circuit height 2500ft QNH.
Runway grass · 700m · condition dry.
Wind check on backleg. Aim for 65kt on final.
Flaps 30 by turning base. Touchdown at numbers.
briefing.atmosphere:
Deer possible on runway edge at dawn.
Use the trim. Let her settle.
Grease it on.

briefing.orders:
Ground run and low pass. Display axis: runway centreline.
DB 601 warm-up: 3 minutes at 800 RPM minimum.
Max RPM display pass: 2400. Gear stays down.
Taxi back via delta. Crowds left of runway.
briefing.atmosphere:
This aircraft last flew in combat on 24 January 1942,
near Titovka, Russian Arctic.
The pilot was never found.

An Englishman is flying her home.

briefing.orders:
Morning patrol. Marne sector, south bank.
Enemy observation balloons reported N.E. at 1800ft.
Altitude 3000ft. Duration 90 minutes.
Engine: Le Rhône 9J. Blip switch controls mixture at low RPM.
Return via Melun field from the west. Signal green.
briefing.atmosphere:
The front is twenty miles east.
You will hear it before you see it.

briefing.orders:
Freie Jagd. Sektor 7-Nord, Kola-Halbinsel.
Feindlicher Luftverkehr über Titovka gemeldet.
Rückkehr bis 14:00. Nach eigenem Ermessen.

Wetter: −22°C · Wind 180/18kt · Sicht 8km
Bewölkung 2000ft · kein Instrumentenflug möglich.
briefing.atmosphere:
Er wusste, dass er zurückkommen würde.
aber er kannte die felder dort unten nicht.

briefing.orders:
CAP assignment. Altitude 15,000 ft over Empress Augusta Bay.
Bogeys reported bearing 350, angels 12, thirty miles.
Engaged mixed formation — Zeros and Vals.
Four kills confirmed. No damage. RTB Ondonga.

Weather: 28°C · Wind 120/12kt · Visibility unlimited
Note: Today is Armistice Day.
briefing.atmosphere:
Twenty-five years since the last one ended.
The Wasp is on your nose.
She has no idea what's coming.

briefing.date: 11 November 1943 · 0830 Local · USS Bunker Hill CV-17
briefing.orders:
Strike escort. Simpson Harbor, Rabaul.
Escort bomber formation from launch to egress.
Expect heavy AA and fighter opposition — 30+ Zeros reported.
No bomber is to be lost to enemy air action.
RTB USS Bunker Hill.

Weather: 28°C · Wind 110/15kt · Visibility unlimited
Note: Today is Armistice Day.
briefing.atmosphere:
Rabaul is the most defended base in the Pacific.
Two hundred aircraft. Heavy AA. Three airfields.
The bombers are counting on you.
No bomber lost. That is the record. Hold it.

briefing.unit: Szkoła Lotnicza Dęblin · Polskie Siły Powietrzne
briefing.orders:
PRZECHWYCENIE — Sektor Wschód, Juli 1955.
Alarm Ost. Unbekanntes Flugzeug — Transponder negativ.
Kurs 090. Steigflug FL420. VK-1 — Vollschub.
Sichtkontakt herstellen. Identität feststellen.

Feuer nur auf ausdrücklichen Befehl der Bodenleitstelle.
Sowjetischer Verbindungsoffizier: Befehlsgewalt liegt bei Moskau.
briefing.atmosphere:
Er saß in einer MiG-15.
Zwölf Jahre zuvor saß er in einem Spitfire.
Beide flogen gut.
Das war das Problem.

briefing.orders:
Reconnaissance mission. Track 015. Climb to FL260.
Coast-out Nordkap — radio silence from that point.
Photographic run FL030–FL050 over target.
Return via own route. Fuel for 9 hours.

Wetter: −14°C · Wind 320/25kt · Sicht 6km
Kein Aufklärungsflugzeug kehrt mit leeren Kameras zurück.
briefing.atmosphere:
Vier Propeller, contra-rotierend.
Das Grollen der NK-12 ist zu hören in Tromsø.
Sie wissen, dass ihr kommt.
Sie können euch nicht aufhalten.

briefing.orders:
Lift EDF: Freewing DF-80-12B @ 6S — 3300g Freiluft.
ESC-Limit: 80% = 2640g effektiv.
Schwebedruck: 3.4 kg × 9.81 / 0.24 m² = 139 Pa.
Schiebregler: Gewicht · Drosselklappe · Schürzendichtheit.
briefing.atmosphere:
Theorie trifft Realität.
Dieser Simulator läuft neben dem echten Hovercraft.
Wenn der Hovercraft schwebt, zeigt die Telemetrie dieselben Werte.

briefing.aircraft:
Timo: 600×400mm · 3.4 kg · Plenum 0.24 m²
Markus (H2D): 320×280mm · 0.8 kg · GPS-Autonomie
briefing.orders:
Zwei Fahrzeuge. Ein Simulator.
Timo: Manuelle Steuerung · Lift + Thrust Regler.
Markus: MANUAL / HOVER / TRACK (GPS-Autopilot).
Vehicle-Selector: TIMO · BEIDE · MARKUS.
briefing.atmosphere:
Faigle3D H2D — Hovercraft Demonstrator.
Dieselbe Physik. Zwei Maßstäbe.
Vergleich: Plenumdruck · Schwebekraft · Wirkungsgrad.

briefing.orders:
Lift EDF: HobbyKing 64mm @ 4S.
Schwebedruck: 0.8 kg × 9.81 / 0.0896 m² = 87.6 Pa.
Autonomie: MANUAL · HOVER · TRACK.
TRACK: Zielpeilung mit Schieberegler setzen.
briefing.atmosphere:
Faigle3D H2D — Hovercraft Demonstrator.
Kleiner. Schneller. Autonom.
GPS-Tracking im Testlauf.

briefing.orders:
Tab — cycle joint (J1–J6)
← → — rotate selected joint (Shift = ×5)
Space — gripper open / close
H — home position

Move the arm through targets A → B → C.
Stay within the safe workspace envelope.
briefing.atmosphere:
The architecture made physical.
Six joints. One black box.
Every command logged. Every decision recorded.

Human always PF.

briefing.orders:
[ / ] — cycle joint
1–0, -, = — jump to joint 1–12
← → — rotate joint  (Shift = ×5)
H — home all joints
L — log transforms to console
briefing.atmosphere:
Four legs. Twelve joints.
One calibration at a time.

The dog stands ready.

briefing.orders:
Departure: UKKM Hostomel. Destination: EDDP Leipzig/Halle.
Flight level: FL390. Route: UKKM–EPWA–EDDP.
Payload: cargo, manifest on board.
Estimated flight time: 2h 45min.

Wetter: +2°C · Wind 220/08kt · Sicht gut
Piste 18 · 2 520 m · Flaps F1 · Vr 175 kt
Vollbremsung bis Pistenende if rejected.
briefing.atmosphere:
Sie ist das einzige ihrer Art auf der Welt.
Gebaut, um das Unmögliche zu tragen.
Heute: Leipzig.

Am 24. Februar beginnt die Invasion.
Am 27. Februar 2022 wird sie auf diesem Flughafen zerstört.

Sie weiß es nicht.
Sie startet.

title: Apollo 13 · Houston, We've Had a Problem

briefing.pilot: CDR: Jim Lovell · CMP: Jack Swigert · LMP: Fred Haise
briefing.aircraft: Saturn V AS-508 · S-IC: 5 × F-1 · 33.4 MN · S-II: 5 × J-2 · S-IVB: 1 × J-2
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Kennedy Space Center LC-39A.
Target: Fra Mauro highlands, lunar surface.

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  F-1 ignition · Liftoff
T+02:35m  TLI ignition
T+55:54m  Oxygen tank explosion — ABORT
T+77:02m  Moon pericynthion — 254 km altitude
T+79:57m  PC+2 burn — LM DPS, 263 s
T+141:30m  LM Aquarius jettisoned
T+142:54m  Reentry

All crew survived.
briefing.atmosphere:
April 11, 1970.
Jim Lovell. Jack Swigert. Fred Haise.

At T+55 hours, an oxygen tank explodes 330,000 km from Earth.
The lunar module Aquarius becomes a lifeboat.
The Moon's gravity becomes the engine that brings them home.

"Houston, we've had a problem."

briefing.pilot: CDR: Frank Borman · CMP: James Lovell · LMP: William Anders
briefing.aircraft: Saturn V AS-503 · S-IC: 5 × F-1 · 33.4 MN · S-II: 5 × J-2 · S-IVB: 1 × J-2
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Kennedy Space Center LC-39A.
Target: Lunar orbit, 112 × 114 km.

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  F-1 ignition · Liftoff
T+00:12  Roll/pitch program
T+01:21  Max Q · 13 km altitude
T+02:15  Center F-1 cutoff
T+02:42  S-IC cutoff · 67 km
T+02:44  S-IC / S-II separation
T+09:11  S-II cutoff · 185 km
T+09:25  S-IVB ignition
T+11:24  Earth parking orbit achieved
T+2h 50m  Translunar injection burn
briefing.atmosphere:
December 21, 1968.
Frank Borman, James Lovell, William Anders.
The first human beings to leave Earth's gravity.

On Christmas Eve, orbiting the Moon, they read from Genesis.
Anders photographed Earthrise.

"We came all this way to explore the Moon,
and the most important thing is that we discovered the Earth."

briefing.aircraft: Merlin 1C · 355 kN SL · Stage 2: Kestrel · 31 kN
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Omelek Island, Marshall Islands.
Target orbit: 621 km circular · 9.35° inclination.
Payload: RatSat (mass simulator, 165 kg).

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  Merlin ignition · Liftoff
T+01:09  Max-Q
T+02:49  MECO · Stage separation
T+02:55  Stage 2 ignition (Kestrel)
T+09:31  SECO · Orbit insertion
briefing.atmosphere:
Three failures.
First: a fuel leak ignited on ascent.
Second: stage-1 re-contacted stage-2.
Third: residual thrust caused re-contact again.

This is the fourth attempt.
They had enough hardware for one more flight.
After this, the program was over — or it was not.

briefing.aircraft: 9× Merlin 1C · 3807 kN SL · Stage 2: MVac · 411 kN
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Cape Canaveral SLC-40.
Target orbit: ~400 km circular · 51.6° inclination.
Payload: Dragon C2+ · ISS cargo.

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  9-engine ignition · Liftoff
T+01:19  Engine 1 failure
T+02:58  MECO · Stage separation
T+03:05  MVac ignition
T+10:10  SECO · Orbit insertion
briefing.atmosphere:
Engine 1 fails at T+79 seconds.

Eight engines carry Dragon to orbit anyway.
ISS gets its cargo.
Orbcomm does not — orbit too low to raise.

The rocket flew the mission on its own terms.

briefing.aircraft: 33× Raptor 2 · 74 MN SL · Ship: 6× Raptor 2 Vac · 7.59 MN
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Starbase OLP-2.
Target trajectory: suborbital · Indian Ocean splashdown.
Payload: 22 Starlink simulators.

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  33-engine ignition · Liftoff
T+02:22  MECO · Stage separation · Hot-stage
T+03:38  Raptor 5 shutdown — guidance extends burn 62 s
T+10:13  SECO on 5 engines — nominal trajectory achieved
T+65:22  Splashdown · Indian Ocean
briefing.atmosphere:
One engine fails.
Guidance rewrites the burn in real time.
The ship reaches orbit anyway.

Booster 19 does not come home.
But the mission is complete.

briefing.aircraft: 33× Raptor 2 · 74 MN SL · Ship: 6× Raptor 2 Vac · 7.59 MN
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Starbase OLP-2.
Target trajectory: one orbit · Starbase return.
Payload: 22 Starlink simulators.

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  33-engine ignition · Liftoff
T+02:22  MECO · Stage separation · Hot-stage
T+07:54  Booster 20 — Mechazilla catch confirmed
T+09:11  SECO · Orbital velocity
T+65:22  Ship 40 — Mechazilla catch confirmed
briefing.atmosphere:
This is a prediction.
Flight has not happened yet.

If the guidance holds and the arms are ready —
for the first time, both stages come home.

briefing.pilot:
CDR  Markus Leutwyler
PLT  Lydia Meier
MS1  Pradeep Sapkota
MS2  TBD
briefing.aircraft: 9× Merlin 1D+ · 7607 kN SL · Stage 2: MVac · 934 kN vac
briefing.orders:
Launch site: Kennedy Space Center LC-39A.
Target orbit: 590 km circular · 51.6° inclination.
Mission duration: 3 days.

Flight sequence:
T+00:00  9-engine ignition · Liftoff
T+01:12  CECO — center engine cutoff
T+02:33  MECO · Stage separation
T+02:53  Boostback burn — 3 engines
T+08:45  SECO · Orbit insertion
T+08:45+ Stage 1 RTLS · LZ-1
briefing.atmosphere:
Four people.
No professional astronauts.
No government agency.

A rocket, a capsule, and a crew that trained for this.
The door Jared opened.
We walked through.

briefing.orders:
On the ramp at Ted Stevens. Start engines, taxi to runway one five.
Climb runway heading, then direct Bozeman.
2,400 km southeast over the Wrangells and the northern Rockies.
briefing.atmosphere:
Anchorage. Mountains on every side.
The Eskimo on the tail has flown this state for seventy years.
Bozeman, Montana — five hours south.

briefing.orders:
On the ramp at Changi. Start the GE90s, taxi to runway two zero centre.
Climb out over the Strait, direct PIBAP, then the long haul northwest.
10,800 km to London Heathrow — thirteen hours.
briefing.atmosphere:
Changi at dusk. The equator heat shimmering off the apron.
The golden bird on the tail, bound for London through the night.
The flagship of Singapore Airlines.
